home.title: Report a civic problem. See who owns the work.
home.lead: Describe what happened, drop a pin like you would in a food-delivery app, and we name the department, officers, MLA, and MP for that place — from sourced records, not guesses. Stay anonymous if you want.
home.how1: What happened, since when, and who is affected. Photos help.
home.how2: Search the street or use your location. Drag the pin if it is a few metres off.
home.how3: Then file. We take it to those offices. You can track the public page anytime.
home.categoriesTitle: What do you want to report?
home.channelsLead: The same offices also run their own apps and numbers — use those in an emergency. File here so neighbours can see the same problem and who must answer.

dashboard.title: Recent reports
dashboard.lead: See what neighbours have filed. Add your voice to an open report instead of creating a duplicate. Closed reports show how the problem was resolved.
dashboard.empty: No reports in this view yet.

report.title: Tell us what happened. Then drop the pin.
report.lead: Details first. Location second. We then show who owns the work — photo, name, and office. Our desk emails those offices after you file.
report.descriptionHint: What happened, since when, who is affected, and any earlier ticket numbers.
report.filesHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF, Word, or plain text. Up to 8 files.
report.locationLead: Search for the area or street. Suggestions list below the box — pick one, or use current location. Drag the pin if it is a few metres off.
report.briefing: Reading sourced records and writing who owns this…
report.needDetails: Write the details first. Then pick a location.
report.needPin: Drop the pin to see who owns this work.
report.deskActs: You are seeing who owns this work. Our desk emails these offices after you file — you do not need to contact them.
report.similarLead: Add your voice to an open case instead of filing a duplicate. Or file a new case if this is a different problem.
report.addVoice: This is still broken — add my voice
report.sensitiveNote: Crime and encroachment reports stay off the public map pin and are not posted on X. Share the tracking link only with people you trust.

filed.title: Case ID {id}
filed.whatsapp: We sent this tracking link on WhatsApp. Save it. We will message you again whenever the status moves.
filed.noWhatsapp: Save this link. Leave a number next time if you want it on WhatsApp.
filed.tweeted: Our desk posted this on X, tagging the offices that own the work.
filed.deskPosts: Our desk posts on X when it is safe to do so. You will not be asked to tweet this.
filed.tweetDraft: Our desk posts on X when it is safe to do so.
filed.quiet: This category is not posted publicly, to protect the reporter.
filed.emailed: We emailed the published office addresses we have on file.

track.unassigned: Our team has this case. We will update this page as it moves.
track.postedX: Posted on X, tagging the offices that own this
track.who: Who we are holding to account
track.slaDone: Clock finished — MLA and MP have been asked.
track.supports: {n} people say this is still broken
track.hiddenPin: Approximate area — exact pin hidden because this category can put someone at risk.
track.confirmLead: The desk thinks the work is done. Only you should close it.
track.afterPhoto: After photo (optional if you say it is fixed, required for the desk to close without you)
track.supportLead: Add your voice. We will not create a second case.
track.rti: RTI draft if they miss the clock
track.closePending: The desk has marked this resolved. The written close-out and proofs will appear here once they are on file.

outcomes.not_civic: Not a civic issue we can take up

map.title: Open cases on the map
map.lead: Reporter names and numbers are never shown. Crime and encroachment sit on an approximate pin.
map.empty: No open cases in public view yet.

board.title: Who is sitting on work
board.lead: Open cases and median days, by assembly and zonal office. League tables need volume — we still show the numbers we have.
board.thin: Fewer than {n} cases so far. Treat ranks as a snapshot, not a verdict.
board.press: Clusters ready for a press note

status.awaiting_confirmation: Waiting for you to confirm the fix
